### ⚽ "Victoria Concordia Crescit" — Victory Through Harmony

I'm a Software Engineering student at the **Vietnam–Korea University of Information and Communication Technology (VKU)**. Much like Arteta builds a disciplined squad at the Emirates, I enjoy crafting reliable software—from full-stack web applications and backend APIs to applied NLP—always playing for the badge with clean, purposeful code.

- 🔭 **Currently focused on:** Full-stack systems with **Next.js** & **NestJS**, caching with **Redis**, and API docs with **Swagger**.
- 🧠 **Exploring:** NLP, semantic search, and candidate ranking workflows in **[Verisem](https://github.com/hvt299/Verisem-Web)**.
- 🎮 **Game Dev:** Building **Dragon Warrior Adventure** (2D platformer in Unity & C#).
- ☁️ **DevOps & Cloud:** Azure, Docker, and automation workflows with **n8n** & **GitHub Actions**.
- 🎯 **Target:** Scoring **700+ TOEIC** and expanding full-stack & AI engineering skills.

### 🚀 Featured Projects

- **[Verisem Web](https://github.com/hvt299/Verisem-Web)** & **[Verisem Backend](https://github.com/hvt299/Verisem-Backend)** — An intelligent recruitment platform exploring CV/job matching, semantic retrieval, and candidate ranking.
- **[Dragon Warrior Adventure](https://github.com/hvt299/DragonWarriorAdventure)** — A 2D action-adventure platformer developed in Unity with custom physics and gameplay mechanics.
